resources.string: Tap Stream screen and allow the capture: the MMI shows this phone\'s screen, up to Max fps pictures a second (the MMI may manage fewer). Format: JPEG is small and fast, PNG keeps text sharp but is bigger and slower, H.264 is smooth video decoded by the MMI\'s video chip (Android 10+, about half a second behind). Latency clock: a big running clock here; a photo of the phone and the MMI together shows how far the MMI is behind. Switch to any app, turn the phone, unplug and replug: the streaming carries on until you stop it here or from its notification.
